Eigenvector spatial filtering

Source: R/sep.R
evfilt.Rd

Adds Moran eigenvectors of the neighbour weights to the regression of v on an intercept and x by forward selection, so that the residuals lose their spatial autocorrelation (Griffith 2003; Tiefelsdorf and Griffith 2007). The Moran eigenvectors are the eigenvectors of the symmetrised weights (W + W') / 2 orthogonal to the constant (computed in the Helmert basis), each with Moran's I n / S0 lambda; the candidates are those with Moran's I above -1 / (n - 1) ("positive", the usual choice), below it, or all. Selection by method: "moran" takes the vector that most reduces the absolute residual Moran's I until it is below tol; "aic" and "press" (the leave-one-out prediction error) while they fall; "r2" while R-squared rises by tol or more. At least two residual degrees of freedom are kept.

Usage

evfilt(
  v,
  w,
  x = NULL,
  method = "moran",
  cand = "positive",
  tol = 0.1,
  maxv = NULL
)

Arguments

v

The outcome: finite numbers, one per area, not all the same.

w

The neighbours, as in lerprc(), for as many areas as v.

x

NULL, or covariates: a numeric matrix (or vector) with one row per area. An intercept is added, so a column that does not vary is refused.

method

"moran", "aic", "press" or "r2".

cand

"positive", "negative" or "all".

tol

The stopping tolerance: one positive number.

maxv

NULL, or the largest number of vectors.

Value

A list of class evfilt: sel (the selected eigenvectors in the order they were added, numbered by decreasing eigenvalue), coef (the intercept, x, then the vectors), imoran (the residual Moran's I), aic, r2, fr2 (the gain in R-squared from the filter), resid and mi (the Moran's I of every eigenvector).

References

Griffith, D. A. (2003). Spatial Autocorrelation and Spatial Filtering. Springer, Berlin. doi:10.1007/978-3-540-24806-4

Tiefelsdorf, M. and Griffith, D. A. (2007). Semiparametric filtering of spatial autocorrelation: the eigenvector approach. Environment and Planning A, 39(5), 1193-1221. doi:10.1068/a37378

See also

Other spatial epidemiology: bayout(), bufexp(), bym2sc(), ecolrg(), kerexp(), lerprc(), sfrail(), spbias(), spsir()

Examples

w <- 1 * (abs(outer(1:8, 1:8, "-")) == 1)
v <- c(1, 2, 2.5, 4, 3.5, 3, 1.5, 1)
evfilt(v, w, method = "aic")
#> evfilt: 1 eigenvectors selected, residual Moran's I -0.7032, R-squared 0.9199
